{
 "path": "programs/task-221cd644.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate the 2-colored separator and the main non-background object.
    sep = 2
    positions = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == sep]
    if not positions:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    rs, cs = [r for r, c in positions], [c for r, c in positions]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in grid for v in row))
    obj_colors = [v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (bg, sep)]
    if not obj_colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    obj = max(set(obj_colors), key=obj_colors.count)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Extend a contrasting adjacent stripe from the object's free side, away from separator.
    if len(set(rs)) == 1:  # horizontal separator: stripe parallel to it
        rsep = rs[0]
        obj_rows = [r for r in range(h) if obj in grid[r]]
        if rsep > max(obj_rows):
            rline = min(obj_rows) - 1
        else:
            rline = max(obj_rows) + 1
        if 0 <= rline < h:
            out[rline] = [obj + 1 if obj < 9 else obj - 1] * w
    elif len(set(cs)) == 1:  # vertical separator
        csep = cs[0]
        obj_cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] == obj for r in range(h))]
        if csep > max(obj_cols):
            cline = min(obj_cols) - 1
        else:
            cline = max(obj_cols) + 1
        if 0 <= cline < w:
            color = obj + 1 if obj < 9 else obj - 1
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][cline] = color
    return out
"
}
